metadata.notes: Owner determined 2026-10-10 that part numbers and label dimensions are public product data; Rotula is not affiliated with the brands listed; brand and product names belong to their owners. Gap between labels along the roll is not stored by any source; leave it to printer calibration unless an entry states a sensing mode. verified=true means the size was parsed consistently AND cross-checked by a second, independent statement. The 'verification' field says how: '2+ sources agree on size' = the ZipShip catalogue PDF and the ZebraDesigner stock export agree; 'export-name+units' = export only, where the stock name text, the micrometre columns and the display-unit columns all agree; 'catalogue-pdf-only' = stated by the ZipShip PDF extraction alone, so not verified. Entries with verified=false need a person to check them (see stock-catalog-unparsed.csv). Each entry lists its sources so one source can be dropped later.
